title: Corporate Finance & Valuations
institution: Bayes Business School, City St George's, University of London
description: Advanced corporate finance course covering capital structure theory, payout policies, valuation methodologies (DCF, Multiples, LBO), cost of capital estimation, risk management, and capital budgeting decisions.

title: Mergers & Acquisitions and Corporate Restructuring
institution: Bayes Business School, City St George's, University of London
description: Comprehensive analysis of M&A transactions, takeover defense strategies, deal structuring, regulatory frameworks, antitrust review, target valuation, proxy contests, and post-merger integration challenges.

title: Empirical Research Methods in Corporate Finance
institution: Bayes Business School, City St George's, University of London
description: Doctoral-level seminar examining frontier econometric techniques in empirical corporate finance: instrumental variables, difference-in-differences, regression discontinuity, panel data, machine learning applications, and text analysis in financial research.

title: Corporate Governance & Executive Incentives
institution: Bayes Business School, City St George's, University of London
description: Undergraduate module exploring agency theory, board composition, executive compensation design, institutional shareholder voting, ESG integration, and international governance systems.
